name.en-US: On the Sacraments of the Christian Faith
name.pt-BR: Sobre os sacramentos da fé cristã

description.la: Summa Hugonis de sacramentis christianae fidei, in duobus libris et triginta partibus: ab opere conditionis ad opera restaurationis, ab initio mundi ad finem saeculi.
description.en-US: Hugh of St. Victor’s great summa of theology, in two books and thirty parts: the works of creation and the works of restoration, from the six days to the end of the world, with the sacraments of the Church at its centre. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 176, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A grande suma teológica de Hugo de São Vítor, em dois livros e trinta partes: as obras da criação e as obras da restauração, do princípio do mundo ao fim dos tempos, com os sacramentos da Igreja no centro.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 176 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text HuDeSVi.DeSac3, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
